question: Which of the following Sultans of Khilji dynasty started paying cash salaries to his soldiers and controlled the market during his reign?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alauddin Khilji**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alauddin Khilji** was the Sultan of Delhi from 1296 to 1316.
 
• He was the first Sultan of Delhi to pay his soldiers in cash rather than through jagirs (land grants).
 
• Alauddin Khilji implemented a significant market control policy to regulate prices and prevent hoarding and black marketing.
 
• His market reforms included the establishment of various markets, price control mechanisms, and rigorous punishments for violations.
 
• These measures helped stabilize the economy and ensured the availability of goods at fair prices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alauddin Khilji**'s reign is noted for his military conquests, administrative reforms, and efforts to curb the power of the nobility.
 
• He successfully repelled several Mongol invasions, thereby securing the northern borders of his empire.
 
• Alauddin's administrative reforms included measures to curb corruption and enhance revenue collection.
 
• He established a strong spy network to keep an eye on the activities of the nobles and officials.
 
• His reign marked a significant period in the history of the Delhi Sultanate, characterized by economic stability and military strength.
